verdict.rationale: Moss documents official Python and TypeScript/JavaScript (Node, `@moss-js/moss`) SDKs, with per-SDK details such as `min_score`/`minScore`, disk caching, and a MossClient reference. It also lists Swift, Elixir, C, and a WASM build, but the evidence never mentions Go or Java SDKs, so only half of the named major languages are covered. missing for 10: official Go SDK, official Java SDK, independent corroboration of SDK quality.
